subject: ISO 27001 scope vs. FedRAMP evidence retention — clarification and fallback options
content:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@trustaudits.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@blue-tide.com, audit-logistics@blue-tide.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify: retention windows and scope boundaries for ISO/FedRAMP mapping

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intake call last week. To prepare the sample request for the upcoming FedRAMP readiness assessment (tentative window: May 9–13), we need a few clarifications to map controls between ISO 27001 and the FedRAMP-aligned control set:

1) Evidence retention windows — for controls where the policy says "retain logs for 12 months" vs. FedRAMP’s 24-month expectation, which retention window should we evaluate against?
2) Scope boundary assumptions — can you confirm whether the dedicated inference cluster in eu-central-1 is inside the ISO scope or treated as an external managed service?
3) Fallback plan — if a required snapshot or log cannot be produced for a 24-month sample, do you have a documented compensating control or attestation process we should include in the report?

If you can share the scope matrix and the retention policy excerpts, we’ll start drafting the sample list.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Auditor, TrustAudits

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@trustaudits.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify: retention windows and scope boundaries for ISO/FedRAMP mapping

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Retention windows: our baseline (ISO-aligned) retention is 12 months for most operational logs, but for regulated customers and FedRAMP workflows we mirror a 24-month retention in the archival tier. For the assessment, please treat the *default* production retention as 24 months for the services we’ve flagged as FedRAMP-eligible. I’ve attached a short "evidence_retention_summary.pdf" with mappings.

2) Scope boundary: the dedicated inference cluster in eu-central-1 is currently inside our ISO scope (we onboarded it for ISO control coverage last quarter). However, a subset of storage snapshots for customer data is managed by our partner (BlueTide) — those artifacts are in their environment and require cross-organization evidence pulls.

3) Fallback/compensating controls: where a 24-month artifact is unavailable (e.g., rolling logs older than 12 months that were never archived), we rely on a documented compensating control: immutable audit exports from the time-range (hosted by BlueTide), supplemented by retention policy signed attestations and snapshot manifests. I asked BlueTide to confirm availability — see their note below.

Next steps: Marissa, can you pull the iso_scope_matrix.xlsx from the compliance drive and drop the link? Grace, please enumerate owners for the eu-central-1 control set and confirm whether any retention exceptions were granted in the last 18 months. Jonas, if you can run a quick dry-run to confirm which snapshots are already archived for the May window that would be helpful.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): evidence_retention_summary.pdf

---

On Wed, 31 Mar 2027 at 08:26 AM, compliance@blue-tide.com <compliance@blue-tide.com> wrote:
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@trustaudits.com>
Cc: audit-logistics@blue-tide.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:26:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify: retention windows and scope boundaries for ISO/FedRAMP mapping

Hi Kimberly and Sarah,

We confirm the following for BlueTide-managed artifacts:
- Long-term archival for customer snapshots is retained for 30 months in cold storage (meets/ exceeds 24-month FedRAMP expectation).
- We can provide time-stamped manifests and the cryptographic checksums for any requested snapshot range.
- For log ranges where raw logs were rotated before archiving, we can provide aggregated attestations plus the ingestion receipts and export manifests.

We attached a preliminary evidence_sample_manifest.csv with the snapshot IDs we think will match your sample window. If you need us to push retrieval jobs into the cold tier ahead of the audit, let us know the exact IDs and retrieval SLA (we recommend 72 hours).

Regards,
BlueTide Compliance Ops

Attachment(s): evidence_sample_manifest.csv
